# FDG4037

> DO NOT provide reserved enum values that are intended for future use.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.8 Enum Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1700
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

CA1700 reports enum values whose names contain 'Reserved'. Reserved values with other names are not detected. CA1700 has no code fix.

## From the book

You can always simply add values to the existing enum at a later stage. Section 4.8.2 provides more details on adding values to enums. Reserved values just pollute the set of real values and tend to lead to user errors.

```csharp
public enum DeskType {
  Circular,
  Oblong,
  Rectangular,

  // the following two values should not be here
  ReservedForFutureUse1,
  ReservedForFutureUse2,
}
```
